ops.prevDaySetup: Exhibition load-in is in principle from 9:00 p.m. the day before. On exhibition load-in and load-out days, 20% of the exhibition room fee is added as a load-in/load-out charge. Use of the venue before 9:00 a.m. or after 9:00 p.m. on the day is charged at a surcharge.
ops.parking: A tower-type parking lot for 70 cars and a few flat parking spaces (priority for wheelchair users). Vehicle limits are 5.5 m in length, 1.88 m in width and 1.55 m in height. The fee is 200 yen per 30 minutes, and banquet guests get 4 hours free. Parking reservations are not accepted. When the lot is full, or when the flat spaces cannot be used because of banquet use, guests are directed to nearby partner paid parking lots (time beyond the hotel's free period is at the user's expense).
ops.vehicleRules: Trucks and buses cannot park. If parking is needed, for example for group use, contact the hotel in advance.
ops.catering: Banquet drinks include bottled beer 800 yen, wine (bottle) 4,500 yen and sake barrel (4-to; 2-to of contents) 130,000 yen. Rental equipment starts from projector 20,000 yen, screen 3,000 yen and master of ceremonies 80,000 yen (all prices shown excluding tax, as of November 2026). Bringing in commemorative gifts and bouquets is also accepted, and items other than perishables can be stored from the day before.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the tempura, shabu-shabu and kaiseki restaurant Nakatsugawa, the Chinese restaurant Ronfan (龍皇) (private rooms for 6-26 guests), and the cafe dining Palm Tree (a private party plan from 25 guests on weekday dinners). Year-end and New Year party plans are for 2-16 guests at Nakatsugawa and 6-26 guests at Ronfan.
